title: ApiError
description: The single error shape for every /v1 endpoint, per API.md. RCE-053. details carries safe field and constraint diagnostics only — never stack traces, never secret canonical facts, never another owner's revision.

ErrorCode.description: Stable codes. FRESHNESS_UNAVAILABLE is the retryable dependency failure ADR-004 requires when required state or visibility cannot be reconstructed completely.

StatusMatrix.description: Not a validation schema — the normative code-to-status mapping from API.md, kept beside the codes so the two cannot drift. 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST; 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; 403 FORBIDDEN; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 STALE_REVISION, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, STATE_CONFLICT; 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE; 422 SCHEMA_REJECTED, DOMAIN_REJECTED; 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED; 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED; 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, FRESHNESS_UNAVAILABLE. A model refusal is NOT an HTTP error: it is a typed failed turn outcome with code provider_refused.
